normalization: Assets already have intentional category-dependent levels. Do not peak-normalize all files to the same volume.
runtimeHeadroom: Keep one master dynamics stage as a safety net and profile real simultaneous events; static asset checks do not guarantee every game mix will remain unclipped.
eventRules: Unlock Web Audio only after a user gesture; preload short essential effects after consent.
Use the catalog's per-cue cooldown and a shuffle bag with no consecutive variant repeat.
Use at most one stone impact, one splat, and one score tick per landing.
Multi-kills use gameplay.multikill instead of layering all killed creatures; its body replaces the separate thud.
For giant 3x3 squash, aggregate the whole landing before selecting sound; do not play nine separate multikill cues.
Coalesce score changes inside 70 ms. Use the current combo tier capped at 8.
Combo milestone cues replace the ordinary score tick; rampage and level-up replace combo cues.
If rampage and level-up happen together, play rampage immediately and delay level-up 300 ms or suppress the lower priority cue.
Damage cue replaces generic hurt and combo-break feedback for that event.
Poison and daze status cues play only when the status first starts; optional poison ticks are at most 1 Hz.
Low-health cue triggers on threshold crossing, with hysteresis; never every frame or every damage tick.
UI clicks are mutually exclusive: tab, navigation, equip or modal cue takes precedence over generic press.
Play success only after the corresponding save, login or purchase actually succeeds.
New unlock reveal replaces purchase sound; do not stack both.
Game-over interrupts ordinary movement and kill voices. Space results rewards after its transient.
Do not add sounds to every coin digit, DOM update, keystroke, or loading animation frame.
Pause suspends gameplay events; mute takes effect immediately, including active tails.
Optional hover, slider, poison ticks and incidental creature movement begin disabled.
Positional game sounds are mono; map pan and distance in the engine. Reward stingers have a subtle stereo tail.
Random pitch shifts are suitable for impacts within +/-3%; keep melodic score tiers and reward motifs in tune.
formatSelection: Use decoded WAV as compatibility fallback; prefer Ogg when supported. Decode once into AudioBuffers and reuse them.
loops: None in this pack. Continuous ambient or music loops are not required by the existing audio module.
review: Audition preview.html on headphones and phone speakers, then review gameplay density during integration.
